parsed.critic: High-cement C07/C08 lack slag and fly ash, so heat and shrinkage at 520-540 kg/m3 cement may limit field strength gain, and C08's low 2.5 kg/m3 superplasticizer at 0.30 w/b risks stiff, poorly consolidated mixes; tree disagreement (8.8-12.1 MPa) shows these predictions are estimates, not measured.
parsed.selection_rationale: C08 and C03 combine low water-to-binder with moderate superplasticizer, closest to the observed strongest mixes, so they merit first testing despite modest predicted upside.

decision.analyst: High-cement ternary mixes with moderate water reach the top of the observed range, while low-cement high-fly-ash mixes with high water collapse.
decision.hypothesis: Increasing total binder (cement plus slag) while holding water near 160-175 kg/m3 and water/binder at or below ~0.35 will raise measured 28-day strength above the ~76 MPa observed best.
decision.critic: High-cement C07/C08 lack slag and fly ash, so heat and shrinkage at 520-540 kg/m3 cement may limit field strength gain, and C08's low 2.5 kg/m3 superplasticizer at 0.30 w/b risks stiff, poorly consolidated mixes; tree disagreement (8.8-12.1 MPa) shows these predictions are estimates, not measured.
decision.selection_rationale: C08 and C03 combine low water-to-binder with moderate superplasticizer, closest to the observed strongest mixes, so they merit first testing despite modest predicted upside.
